role: MCP tool: search function/type source code in PKG via regex pattern matching on CodeBlock nodes
detail: Exports handleSearchContent() which accepts pattern, fileFilter, and maxResults (capped at 50). Primary query traverses parent-[:HAS_CODE]->CodeBlock edges to find functions/types with matching bodyText; fallback searches old-style bodyText on Function nodes directly. Returns formatted text with matched function/type metadata (name, file, line range, async/export flags, return type) plus up to 5 matching code lines per result. Case-insensitive regex matching via escapeRegex() utility. Max response ~500-3000 tokens per docstring.
gotchas: Fallback query only runs if primary CodeBlock query returns zero results; bodyText on Function nodes is legacy pattern; no handling of multiline bodyText edge cases beyond naive split('\n')
